integrity: The theorem is based on an explicit incidence criterion and integration, with a symbolic/numeric checker supplied for reproducibility. The numerical experiments are not evidence for the universal quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: For independently arclength-uniform perimeter points on a nondegenerate Euclidean triangle and centroid-homothetic Steiner inellipses only; not a motion-invariant random-line model and not an optimization among all inellipses. Comparison with all unpublished or unindexed equivalent calculations is impossible. The mathematical result has not undergone independent validation.
title: The universal endpoint-chord law for the Steiner inellipse of a triangle
